newsitem.title: USA: Thermo TerraTech acquires Randers stake.
newsitem.headline: Thermo TerraTech acquires Randers stake.

text.p: Thermo TerraTech Inc said Tuesday it has purchased a controlling interest in Randers Group Inc.

Thermo TerraTech purchased 7.1 million shares of Randers common stock from certain members of Randers' management, and 420,000 shares from Thermo Power Corp, an affiliate of Thermo TerraTech, at a price of $0.625 per share.

Following these transactions, Thermo TerraTech owns about 53.3 percent of Randers' outstanding common stock. In addition, Thermo Electron Corp, parent firm of Thermo TerraTech, owns about 8.9 percent of Randers common stock.

Thermo TerraTech also said it agreed to transfer its wholly owned engineering and consulting businesses, including the Killam group of companies, to Randers in exchange for newly issued shares of Randers common stock.
The exact price for these businesses is still under negotiation, but in no event would be less than the book value of the transferred businesses as of the closing of the transfer.
The number of new shares of Randers common stock to be issued to Thermo TerraTech would equal the agreed price divided by $0.625.

The transfer is expected to be completed in about 90 days, and requires completion by Randers of a due diligence investigation, receipt of an opinion from an investment bank that the transaction is fair to Randers from a financial point of view, approval of the transaction by Randers' shareholders, and regulatory approvals.

Randers, based in Muskegon, Mich., provides design engineering, project management, and construction services for industrial clients in the manufacturing, pharmaceutical, and chemical-processing industries. The company had revenues of $12.4 million in 1996.
Thermo TerraTech provides environmental services for remediation of soil and fluids, laboratory testing, and metal treating.
